data.name: Cathryn
data.gender_notes: Cathryn is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Katharos, meaning pure or clean. In the New Testament, Catharine is a variant of Catherine, which means 'pure' or 'clear'. The name Cathryn carries the meaning “Pure, Clean” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Cathryn usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, clean and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes purity of heart and soul.
data.etymology: Cathryn belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Clean.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Cathryn total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: קתרין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קתרין מקורו במילה היוונית 'קתרוס', שפירושה טוהר וקדושה. השם קתרין הוא נגזר מהמילה העברית 'קתרוס', שמשמעותה היא לטהר ולהקדיש. השם קתרין מוזכר במסורת הנוצרית כהתייחסות לטוהר וקדושה של הנשמה.

in_greek.name: Καθρυν
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Καθρυν προέρχεται από το ελληνικό 'Καθαρίνη', που σημαίνει καθαρό και αγία. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Καθρυν συμβολίζει την αγιότητα και την καθαρότητα της ψυχής. Το όνομα Καθρυν συνδέεται με την έννοια της πνευματικής κάθαρσης και της προσήλωσης στο Θεό.

in_latin.name: Cathryn
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Cathryn derivatur ex verbo Graeco 'Katharos', quod significat puritatem et sanctimoniam. In traditione Christiana, nomen Cathryn refertur ad puritatem et sanctitatem animae. Cathryn est nomen quod significat devotionem ad Deum et munditiam cordis.

in_english.name: Cathryn
in_english.long_meaning: The name Cathryn originates from the Greek word 'Katharos', meaning pure or clear. In Christian tradition, Cathryn symbolizes spiritual purity and holiness. The name is associated with devotion to God and cleanliness of heart. Historically, Cathryn has been used across various Christian cultures, signifying a connection to faith and moral integrity.

data.cultural_impact: Catharine was an early Christian martyr in Alexandria, Egypt, known for her virtue and purity, which made her an inspiring figure for Christians.
data.spiritual_significance: Cathryn is an evocative name for a Christian, symbolizing purity of thought, word, and deed, and a striving for a life free of sin. It is a reminder of the call to holiness and the importance of living in accordance with God's will.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Cathryn, derived from Catherine, signifies "pure" or "clear" in Greek. It embodies the virtues of purity, clarity, and innocence, inspiring one to live a simple, uncluttered, and radiant life.

name_in_real_life.story: Grace Cathryn from London, United Kingdom embodies the meaning of Cathryn - "Pure, Clean". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.
